summary: Surface-only review: reused independent 1024px roughness/normal fields with the accepted .22/.08 normal scale and .18 anisotropy. Grazing and neutral captures show directional metal brushing on the housing, real rim bevel highlights and coherent dark cell recesses; the glass/core recipes and geometry are unchanged. Four visible-footprint material comparisons pass (glass .8811, titanium .9655, emerald .8958, prism .7831). Closed/deployed geometry, turntables, phase/contact measurements and sampled self-intersection checks pass. The short reference-inspired cartridge and original glass-ring forms remain deliberate adaptations; final neon lighting and application timing are not accepted by this surface review. Render-call optimization remains Task 8.

features.notes: Curved closed glass and permanently open-sided retaining clips separate clear optics from metal without changing the seven-group inventory.

Real component-hidden footprint tests pass for the closed hero, intermediate opening and full reference-angle inspection; density-backed internal fluorescence retains the approved core geometry/material.
Four retained clips per new cell meet their radial support arms; all 28 rail sockets and 16 linkage arms remain within measured tolerances.
Capped housing sectors and retainer clips remain closed; independent topology, winding and sampled self-intersection checks pass.
Preserved exterior glass/green/shard identity and absolute phase poses; automatic app scheduling remains Task 7.
